import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess

ROOT = Path('/root/.codex/worktrees/f396/medaka')
OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
records = []

def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

def run(argv, label, timeout=300):
    env = {k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(('MEDAKA_', 'GC_'))}
    env.update(MEDAKA_ROOT=str(ROOT), MEDAKA_STRICT='1', CC='clang', MEDAKA_CLANG_OPT='-O2')
    result = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=ROOT, text=True, capture_output=True, env=env, timeout=timeout)
    row = dict(label=label, argv=argv, returncode=result.returncode, stdout=result.stdout,
               stderr=result.stderr, environment={k:v for k,v in env.items()
                                                 if k.startswith(('MEDAKA_', 'GC_')) or k=='CC'})
    records.append(row)
    (OUT/(label+'.stdout')).write_text(result.stdout)
    (OUT/(label+'.stderr')).write_text(result.stderr)
    (OUT/'commands.json').write_text(json.dumps(records, indent=2)+'\n')
    if result.returncode:
        raise RuntimeError(row)
    return result

def definitions(text):
    result = {}
    active = None
    for line in text.splitlines():
        match = re.match(r'^define i64 @([^ (]+)\(', line)
        if match:
            active = match.group(1)
            assert active not in result, active
            result[active] = []
        if active:
            result[active].append(line)
            if line == '}':
                active = None
    return {name:'\n'.join(lines)+'\n' for name,lines in result.items()}

def closure(funcs, seed):
    seen, pending = set(), [seed]
    while pending:
        name = pending.pop()
        if name in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(name)
        assert name in funcs, name
        for callee in re.findall(r'call i64 @(mdk_[^ (]+)', funcs[name]):
            if callee in funcs:
                pending.append(callee)
    return sorted(seen)

def manifest(funcs, names):
    rows = {}
    for name in names:
        body = funcs[name]
        all_branches = len(re.findall(r'br i1', body))
        traps = len(re.findall(r'br i1 .*label %(?:intovf|divzero)[0-9]+,', body))
        patterns = [r'call i64 @mdk_value_(?:eq|ne|lt|le|gt|ge)\(',
                    r'call i64 @mdk_impl_Array_index\(', r'call i64 @mdk_array__setInPlace\(',
                    r'call i64 @mdk_array_make\(', r'call i64 @mdk_array_copy\(', r'call i64 @']
        rows[name] = [all_branches-traps, *[len(re.findall(pattern, body)) for pattern in patterns], traps]
    return rows

def manifest_text(rows):
    return ''.join(name+' '+' '.join(map(str, rows[name]))+'\n' for name in sorted(rows))

inputs = [*ROOT.glob('compiler/**/*.mdk'), *ROOT.glob('stdlib/**/*.mdk'), *ROOT.glob('pds/**/*.mdk'), ROOT/'runtime/medaka_rt.c',
          ROOT/'pds/tools/ct_ir_canonical.awk', ROOT/'pds/test/constant_time_signing.sh',
          ROOT/'medaka', ROOT/'medaka_emitter']
inputs = [p for p in inputs if not p.name.endswith('_test.mdk')]
before = {str(p.relative_to(ROOT)):sha(p) for p in inputs}
head = run(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'], 'head').stdout.strip()
run(['clang','--version'], 'clang-version')
source = ROOT/'pds/test/constant_time_signing_main.mdk'
binary = OUT/'signing-internal'
run([str(ROOT/'medaka'),'build',str(source),'-o',str(binary),'--keep-ir'], 'carrier-build')
raw = binary.with_suffix('.ll')
(OUT/'signing-internal.raw.ll').write_bytes(raw.read_bytes())
canon = run(['awk','-f',str(ROOT/'pds/tools/ct_ir_canonical.awk'),str(raw)], 'canonicalize').stdout
(OUT/'signing-internal.canonical.ll').write_text(canon)
ran = run([str(binary)], 'carrier-run')
assert ran.stdout.splitlines()[-1] == 'PASS signing-value-carrier', ran
current = definitions(canon)
full_names = closure(current, 'mdk_lib_secp256k1__ecdsaSignDigestForTest')
secret_names = closure(current, 'mdk_lib_secp256k1__signCandidate')
(OUT/'full-closure.lst').write_text('\n'.join(full_names)+'\n')
(OUT/'secret-closure.lst').write_text('\n'.join(secret_names)+'\n')
current_rows = manifest(current, full_names)
(OUT/'control.manifest').write_text(manifest_text(current_rows))
old_funcs = definitions((OUT/'old-signing-internal.ll').read_text())
old_names = closure(old_funcs, 'mdk_lib_secp256k1__ecdsaSignDigestForTest')
old_rows = manifest(old_funcs, old_names)
assert manifest_text(old_rows) == (OUT/'old-control.manifest').read_text(), 'old raw IR does not realize pinned manifest'
changes = {name:dict(old=old_rows.get(name), current=current_rows.get(name))
           for name in sorted(set(old_rows)|set(current_rows)) if old_rows.get(name)!=current_rows.get(name)}
for name in changes:
    if name in old_funcs:
        (OUT/(name+'.old.ll')).write_text(old_funcs[name])
    if name in current:
        (OUT/(name+'.current.ll')).write_text(current[name])
after = {str(p.relative_to(ROOT)):sha(p) for p in inputs}
assert before == after, 'source/compiler/runtime changed during carrier reproduction'
grades = {name:run(['cksum',str(OUT/name)], 'cksum-'+name).stdout.split()[:2]
          for name in ['full-closure.lst','control.manifest']}

              raw_ir_sha256=sha(OUT/'signing-internal.raw.ll'), canonical_ir_sha256=sha(OUT/'signing-internal.canonical.ll'),
              binary_sha256=sha(binary), full_closure_grade=grades['full-closure.lst'],
              control_grade=grades['control.manifest'], changed_rows=changes,
              old_provenance=json.loads((OUT/'old-provenance.json').read_text()),
              driver_sha256=sha(Path(__file__)), driver_text=Path(__file__).read_text(),
              manifest_columns=['control','value_comparisons','array_index','array_write','array_make','array_copy','direct_i64_calls','traps'],
              limitations='No security manifest changes or full mutation/taint gate execution. Old IR matches exact expected manifest and nine current source hashes; original compiler commit is not established.')
(OUT/'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2)+'\n')
